name: efusa
description: Sistema EFUSA - gestión de jugadores, pagos y alertas

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.migrate:v7: node -e "import('pg').then(async m=>{const {Pool}=m; const fs=await import('fs'); const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}}); const sql=fs.readFileSync('./sql/migracion_002_v7.sql','utf8'); await p.query(sql); console.log('V7 OK'); await p.end()})"
